story.title: Story 5: Inspection, Reporting, Snapshot, And Export

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on quick-fix 006 for prior findings SV-05-F1 and SV-05-F2, including the touched lhx readiness production path, added/updated tests, direct reproduction of the prior human-output crash, and required story/package gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Current `formatReadinessHuman()` iterates known maintenance sections and safely defaults absent entries with optional chaining and unknown/zero values at `packages/lh-context/src/output/format.ts:100-104`. The prior repro command now returns `exitCode:0` with human output showing `Maintenance background/manualRepair/prepare: status=unknown ...` instead of throwing. Added formatter coverage asserts missing maintenance sections render without crashing at `packages/lh-context/test/output/format.test.ts:35-70`.

Current `projectionReadiness()` checks missing/generated failure states before allowing `ready`: missing, `blocked`, and `write_failed` map to blocked; issues, `degraded`, and `reload_failed` map to degraded; only then can an existing generated file with records become ready at `packages/lh-context/src/core/inspectors.ts:229-235`. Added SQLite inspection coverage seeds stale existing rollout files with `write_failed` and `reload_failed` and verifies blocked/degraded outcomes at `packages/lh-context/test/core/sqlite-inspection.test.ts:319-375`.

verified: Scope-In: lhx reads SQLite-backed readiness state
DoD: lhx summary/tokens/bands/report/readiness can inspect SQLite-backed state
